about.description: Classify Markdown notes and see their classifications in the file explorer and note header.
about.author: By {author}
intro.title: Getting started with Classificator
intro.noteDescription: Use the note header badge, the file menu, or the command palette. Classificator saves your choice in the classification property.
intro.defaultsTitle: Set a default for new notes
intro.defaultsDescription: In Classificator settings, choose whether new empty notes get a default classification, prompt you, or wait for manual classification.
intro.foldersDescription: Open a folder’s context menu to set a default in _meta.md. In automatic mode, the folder value takes priority for new empty notes directly in that folder.
